messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need social copy + assets for the Low-Latency Serving launch next Tue. Plan is X (single post + thread) and LinkedIn (longer post). I have two high-level goals: 1) drive signups; 2) seed webinar registrants. Need owners for scheduling, final copy, and lead routing. What do we have and what's missing? :calendar:

Ravi Chen: I can draft two caption variants for each channel by EOD today. Variant A: product-first (latency numbers + link). Variant B: narrative-first (cost/scale story). Will include short thread outline for X (3 tweets).

Connor Diaz: I'll handle scheduling in Buffer and add tracking. Proposed post times: X at 10:00 PT on launch day, LinkedIn at 11:00 PT. For UTMs use template: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lowlatency_launch_v1` — that lets SDRs see origin. Also recommend pinning the webinar signup on X replies for 48 hours.

Lina Gomez: Assets needed from design: hero image (1200x675), 15s motion clip, and a 30s vertical for amp stories. ETA for first drafts: tomorrow 3pm PT. Also confirm logo lockups and legal blurb.

Maya Patel: Great — also can we do a small CTA test: push Variant A to 60% of X audience and Variant B to 40% to see signup lift? We should decide now so Buffer can split. Connor, can Buffer do weighted posting?

Connor Diaz: Buffer can't do weighted A/B on the same handle — we'll simulate by scheduling A and B to slightly different time windows and monitor first-hour traffic. I'll tag posts with `lowlatency_A` / `lowlatency_B` in the UTM.

Ravi Chen: Draft copy snippet for X thread (first pass):
- Tweet 1: "Serving large models at production scale shouldn't mean 10s of seconds. Meet Low-Latency Serving — sub-100ms inference for common prompt sizes."
- Tweet 2: "We tuned batching, caching, and quantized kernels — customers see 3x lower p99 latency. Sign up to try: <link>"
- Tweet 3: "Join our launch webinar Thu to see a demo + Q&A. Seats limited: <webinar link>"

Lina Gomez: Also tagging product for a quick hero shot — @Maya Patel can you paste the screenshot you want us to highlight?

Maya Patel: Attaching the demo screenshot here. Also note webinar CTA should route leads to the webinar capture form that triggers the SDR flow. Routing rules: if company size >= 1000 employees -> enterprise SDR pool; otherwise inbound SDR queue. Connor can you confirm the field mapping?

Connor Diaz: Confirmed. Form will include `company_size` and `interest_level`. We'll map to `enterprise_sdr` when company_size >= 1000 OR job_title contains "Head/VP/Director". Also adding a Slack webhook to #support-leads to ping SDRs with high-intent leads.

marketing-bot: Calendly event created: "Low-Latency Serving — launch webinar" Thu 11:00 PT. Link: https://calendly.example/lowlatency-launch

Maya Patel: Final asks before sign-off: 1) copy variants in a Google Doc (Ravi), 2) assets in Figma (Lina), 3) Buffer schedule + UTMs (Connor), 4) SDR routing test rules confirmed (Connor). Please post "ready for approval" by tomorrow 12pm PT.

Ravi Chen: Got it — will drop the doc in #marketing-assets when done.

Lina Gomez: Figma link will be up by 3pm. Adding alt text and file size notes.

Connor Diaz: I'll schedule staging posts and share the Buffer links; will also create a short dashboard to monitor first-hour CTRs and conversions.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — once everything is in, I can give final thumbs up. Reminder: we want a short benchmark narrative (one-paragraph) to put in the press kit that highlights target metrics (CTR 1.5%, webinar reg to visit 4%, signup conversion 1%). If we miss these, we iterate creative + CTA within 48 hours. :rocket:
